meta.name: docx
meta.description: Comprehensive document creation, editing, and analysis with support for tracked changes, comments, formatting preservation, and text extraction. When Claude needs to work with professional documents (.docx files) for: (1) Creating new documents, (2) Modifying or editing content, (3) Working with tracked changes, (4) Adding comments, or any other document tasks

copy.tagline: 创建、编辑和分析专业文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理 .docx 格式的专业文档
copy.tagline_en: Create, edit, and analyze professional documents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with .docx professional documents

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以创建、编辑和分析 .docx 文件，包括处理修订、批注、格式保留和文本提取。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 处理 .docx 文件，例如创建新文档、修改内容、查看修订或添加批注时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新的 Word 文档，标题是“项目计划”。
打开这份合同，把“30天”改成“60天”，并显示修订标记。
say.note: Claude 会使用红线工作流，保留修订痕迹。

say.text: 把这个 .docx 文件转换成 Markdown 格式。
say.note: Claude 会使用 pandoc 提取文本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, edit, and analyze .docx files, including tracked changes, comments, formatting preservation, and text extraction.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to work with .docx files, such as creating new documents, modifying content, reviewing changes, or adding comments.

say_en.text: Create a new Word document titled 'Project Plan'.
say_en.note: Claude will use docx-js to generate a .docx file.

say_en.text: Open this contract, change '30 days' to '60 days' with tracked changes.
say_en.note: Claude will use the redlining workflow to preserve revision marks.

say_en.text: Convert this .docx file to Markdown format.
say_en.note: Claude will use pandoc to extract text.
